In detail

This barri saw a genuine and recent cluster of gun violence: a fatal shooting on Carrer de la Mineria on 8 June 2026 was the second lethal shooting on the same street within a month and the third violent incident recently. Officials attribute it to 'ajustes de cuentas' between organized-crime/drug-trafficking groups rather than danger to residents or tourists generally, but multiple fatal public shootings within weeks warrant a cautious rating for both day and especially night. Sources checked: Metrópoli Abierta, 8 June 2026; Telecinco; Infobae; laciutat.cat.
